Incident Bot: INC-2025-02-13-STREAM opened by @elliot.price - OpenAI-compat streaming disconnects in eu-west. Severity: Sev2.

Elliot Price: seeing a spike in client disconnects on /v1/chat/completions stream=true in eu-west. starting ~08:40 UTC. investigating gateway timeouts vs upstream stalls.

Aisha Rahman: support reports from OrchidCRM + BluePeak Analytics. AsterixPay also had similar earlier in week (SUP-2481).

Dev Patel: +1. I also got a ping from FinNova (self-serve) via support form saying stream stops mid answer but no request ids yet.

Hiro Tanaka: any correlated deploys?

Elliot Price: no obvious deploy at 08:40. looks like latency jitter upstream causes gaps; gateway read timeout might be too aggressive for SSE.

Dev Patel: proposing heartbeat comment every 5s + bump proxy_read_timeout on that route. can roll out canary in eu-west in 1h.

Incident Bot: Status update: Mitigation in progress (config change + heartbeat). Next update in 60 min.

Elliot Price: comms plan: if customers ask missing [DONE], advise retry on truncated streams. Aisha will handle outbound notes for OrchidCRM/BluePeak.
